notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Mario Kart World" at completion stage 0. Only 5 subpages exist: "Walkthrough" (about 2,300 characters), "Unlockables" (about 2,000), "Gameplay" (about 1,400), "Controls" (about 1,000) and "Table of Contents" (about 1,500). The contents page lists Characters, Vehicles and Items, then eight cups (Mushroom, Flower, Star, Shell, Banana, Leaf, Lightning, Special), twelve rallies (Golden, Ice, Moon, Spiny, Cherry, Acorn, Cloud, Heart, Drill, Boomerang, Propeller, Turnip), Free Roam and Unlockables; none of the cup or rally pages is written, so only their names and order were used, and splitting them into two chapters each is our own choice. What the rallies are (Fandom has a "Knockout Tour" page) was not checked against StrategyWiki. mariokart.fandom.com answers the API, with about 189 linked pages, including course names, "Knockout Tour", "P-Switch Missions", "Routes" and pages such as "Coin Runners", "Shine Thief" and "Renegade Roundup"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. No online or battle chapter was made, because the StrategyWiki contents do not list one. RAWG gives Nintendo Switch as the platform; StrategyWiki's page summary calls it the first game for Nintendo Switch 2. No Steam app (steam=None).
